SELECT body FROM (VALUES
    ('Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here'),
    ('Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay'),
    ('The client needs the signed quote by 5 pm today.'),

    '{"decide": "Does this need an answer today?"}', body) DESC
